game.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition

roadmap.title: Escape Helgen and complete the main story
roadmap.description: Finish the main quest while activating an early Standing Stone, buying Breezehome, learning a complete shout, and letting dragon-soul and level counters begin naturally.

roadmap.title: Complete the four guilds and civil war
roadmap.description: Finish the Companions, College, Thieves Guild, and Dark Brotherhood routes. Accept Astrid's invitation, complete the four Thieves Guild city restorations, and secure War Hero before Season Unending can alter the fort route.

roadmap.title: Protect the Daedric route and clear Skyrim activities
roadmap.description: Complete the fifteen Daedric artifact routes with the qualifying reward choices, then handle one-off crafting, crime, marriage, and economy tasks while exploration counters continue.

roadmap.title: Finish Dawnguard
roadmap.description: Complete the Dawnguard story and Lost to the Ages, use Auriel's Bow before discarding it, learn Soul Tear through three Durnehviir summons, and finish both transformation perk trees while their forms remain available.

roadmap.title: Build the Hearthfire estates
roadmap.description: Buy all three plots, construct every required house section, and prepare a child's room for adoption. Stockpile iron fittings, locks, hinges, nails, lumber, stone, clay, and gold before the full build.

roadmap.title: Clear Solstheim and the Dragonborn DLC
roadmap.description: Complete Miraak's story, Raven Rock's major side quests, five Black Books, all Dragon Aspect words, five dragon rides, and thirty discoveries. Protect Baldor Iron-Shaper and unlock Stalhrim smithing before cleanup.

roadmap.title: Finish long counters and the Legendary Dragon
roadmap.description: Use the completed quest map for remaining locks, pockets, stones, books, dungeons, locations, shouts, souls, money, and skill levels. Continue leveling to 78 and defeat a naturally spawned Legendary Dragon.

achievements.summary: Complete the opening quest Unbound by escaping @loc{Helgen}.

guide.context: Unbound is the mandatory tutorial and has no prerequisites or route choices that affect later achievements.

steps.text: Choose either survivor in @loc{Helgen Keep}, follow the escape route through the tunnels, and exit the cave into Skyrim.

achievements.summary: Complete Bleak Falls Barrow by recovering the @item{Dragonstone} and delivering it to Farengar in Whiterun.

guide.context: The quest becomes part of Whiterun's main-story route after reporting the dragon attack to Jarl Balgruuf.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Bleak Falls Barrow}, clear the ruin, and take the @item{Dragonstone} from the final draugr.
Return to @npc{Farengar Secret-Fire} in @loc{Dragonsreach} and deliver the Dragonstone to finish Bleak Falls Barrow.

achievements.summary: Complete The Way of the Voice by finishing the Greybeards' training at @loc{High Hrothgar}.

guide.context: The Way of the Voice follows Dragon Rising, after the first dragon soul and the Greybeards' summons establish the shout system.

steps.text: Climb the Seven Thousand Steps from @loc{Ivarstead} and enter @loc{High Hrothgar}.
Speak with @npc{Arngeir}, complete every prompted shout lesson, and demonstrate Whirlwind Sprint to finish the quest.

achievements.summary: Complete Diplomatic Immunity by infiltrating the @loc{Thalmor Embassy} and escaping with the investigation evidence.

guide.context: Delphine temporarily stores normal equipment before the party, so only gear passed to Malborn is available inside the restricted area.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Malborn} in Solitude and give him any equipment needed inside the embassy.
Attend the party, create a distraction, search the embassy for the required dossiers, and escape through the cave to complete Diplomatic Immunity.

achievements.summary: Complete Alduin's Wall by escorting Delphine and Esbern to @loc{Sky Haven Temple}.

guide.context: Alduin's Wall follows the search for Esbern and opens the Blades' base at Sky Haven Temple.

steps.text: Travel with @npc{Delphine} and @npc{Esbern} through Karthspire and open the route into @loc{Sky Haven Temple}.
Stand with Esbern at Alduin's Wall and let the full quest conversation finish.

achievements.summary: Complete Elder Knowledge by recovering the @item{Elder Scroll (Dragon)} through the main-story route.

guide.context: The main quest sends the player to the College of Winterhold for information before the Dwemer ruin sequence that holds the Elder Scroll.

steps.text: Follow Elder Knowledge to @loc{Alftand}, cross Blackreach, and enter @loc{Tower of Mzark}.
Solve the Tower of Mzark control puzzle and take the @item{Elder Scroll (Dragon)} from the mechanism.

achievements.summary: Complete The Fallen by trapping @enemy{Odahviing} inside @loc{Dragonsreach}.

guide.context: The Fallen occurs late in the main story and teaches all three words of Call Dragon for the trap.

steps.text: Secure Jarl Balgruuf's cooperation and prepare the dragon trap on the rear balcony of @loc{Dragonsreach}.
Use Call Dragon, weaken @enemy{Odahviing}, and lure the dragon into the trap until the quest objective updates.

achievements.summary: Complete Dragonslayer by defeating @enemy{Alduin} in @loc{Sovngarde}.

guide.context: Dragonslayer is the final main-story quest and follows the one-way trip through Skuldafn, so finish desired local tasks before riding Odahviing.

steps.text: Ride @enemy{Odahviing} to Skuldafn, clear the temple, and enter the portal to @loc{Sovngarde}.
Join the three ancient heroes, clear Alduin's mist with Clear Skies, and defeat @enemy{Alduin}.

achievements.summary: Join the @mechanic{Companions} by completing the initiation tasks at @loc{Jorrvaskr} in Whiterun.

guide.context: Jorrvaskr is beside Dragonsreach and the faction can be joined without committing to a mutually exclusive guild.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Kodlak Whitemane} in @loc{Jorrvaskr} and accept the Companions' trial.
Finish the weapon test, delivery, and first assigned job, then complete Take Up Arms to become a Companion.

achievements.description: Become a member of the Circle
achievements.summary: Become a member of the @mechanic{Circle} by accepting the werewolf ritual during The Silver Hand.

guide.context: The Circle invitation arrives after several Companions quests and temporarily grants lycanthropy, which is also needed for the Dawnguard werewolf-perk achievement.

steps.text: Complete Companions jobs until @npc{Skjor} starts The Silver Hand.
Meet Skjor beneath @loc{The Underforge} at night and drink @npc{Aela}'s blood to complete the transformation.

achievements.summary: Complete Glory of the Dead to finish the @mechanic{Companions} questline.

guide.context: Glory of the Dead follows the faction's major loss and sends the Circle to Ysgramor's Tomb for the final rite.

steps.text: Travel with the Circle to @loc{Ysgramor's Tomb} and clear the burial route.
Use the witch head at the Flame of the Harbinger, defeat the resulting wolf spirit, and finish the closing conversation.

achievements.summary: Join the @mechanic{College of Winterhold} by passing Faralda's entrance test and entering the College.

guide.context: Faralda waits at the bridge and chooses a spell test; she can sell the required spell when the player does not know it.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Faralda} at the College bridge and cast the spell requested by her dialogue.
Follow Faralda across the bridge and report for the first lesson inside @loc{College of Winterhold}.

achievements.summary: Complete Revealing the Unseen by locating the Staff of Magnus and finishing the @loc{Mzulft} expedition.

guide.context: This College quest follows Containment and uses the Oculory to identify the Staff of Magnus's location.

steps.text: Follow the quest marker through @loc{Mzulft} and recover the focusing crystal.
Place the crystal in the Oculory, use frost or flame magic to align the beams, and complete the projection sequence.

achievements.summary: Complete The Eye of Magnus by defeating @enemy{Ancano} at the @loc{College of Winterhold}.

guide.context: The Eye of Magnus is the College finale; the Staff of Magnus is required to make Ancano vulnerable.

steps.text: Recover the @item{Staff of Magnus}, return to the College, and enter the Hall of the Elements.
Use the Staff of Magnus on the Eye to close its shield, damage @enemy{Ancano} while he is vulnerable, and finish the faction epilogue.

achievements.summary: Join the @mechanic{Thieves Guild} by completing A Chance Arrangement and Taking Care of Business in Riften.

guide.context: Brynjolf starts the route in Riften's market; the guild remains compatible with the other major factions.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Brynjolf} in @loc{Riften}, complete his market scheme, and meet him in the Ragged Flagon.
Complete the three Taking Care of Business debt collections and report back to Brynjolf.

achievements.summary: Complete Darkness Returns by returning the @item{Skeleton Key} to the Twilight Sepulcher.

guide.context: The Skeleton Key is useful as an unbreakable lockpick, but keeping it prevents the Thieves Guild main quest from completing and delays guild restoration.

steps.text: Carry the @item{Skeleton Key} through @loc{Twilight Sepulcher} and complete the Pilgrim's Path.
Place the Skeleton Key in the Ebonmere and select a Nightingale Agent blessing to finish Darkness Returns.

achievements.description: Returned the Thieves Guild to its former glory
achievements.summary: Restore the @mechanic{Thieves Guild} by completing five Delvin or Vex jobs in each of Whiterun, Markarth, Windhelm, and Solitude, then finishing all four special jobs.

guide.context: Only jobs in the four target cities advance restoration; Riften jobs and extra work in an already completed city do not help the four-city requirement.

steps.text: Complete the Thieves Guild main questline through Darkness Returns.
Take jobs from @npc{Delvin Mallory} and @npc{Vex}; complete five jobs apiece in Whiterun, Markarth, Windhelm, and Solitude, declining jobs in unneeded cities.
After each city's fifth job, accept and finish Delvin's unlocked special job; complete all four special jobs and attend the guild restoration ceremony.

achievements.summary: Join the @mechanic{Dark Brotherhood} by completing Innocence Lost and accepting Astrid's invitation in With Friends Like These.

guide.context: Killing Astrid in the abandoned shack starts Destroy the Dark Brotherhood! and closes the entire faction line. The blocked unlocks are With Friends Like These…, Hail Sithis!, and Bound Until Death.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Aventus Aretino} in Windhelm, complete Innocence Lost, and wait for the courier's black-hand message.
Sleep in any bed, speak with @npc{Astrid} in the abandoned shack, kill one of her captives, and accept the sanctuary invitation.

achievements.summary: Complete Bound Until Death by carrying out the Dark Brotherhood contract at Vittoria Vici's wedding.

guide.context: The quest is available only on the Astrid route and follows The Silence Has Been Broken.

steps.text: Complete Dark Brotherhood contracts until @npc{Astrid} assigns Bound Until Death.
Travel to @loc{Solitude}, eliminate @npc{Vittoria Vici} during her wedding appearance, escape, and report to Astrid.

achievements.summary: Complete Hail Sithis! by finishing the final @mechanic{Dark Brotherhood} assassination contract.

guide.context: Hail Sithis! follows Death Incarnate and concludes the Brotherhood's primary questline.

steps.text: Follow the contract route onto @loc{The Katariah} and reach the Emperor's cabin.
Kill the Emperor, leave the ship, collect the payment, and complete the final report to finish Hail Sithis!.

achievements.description: Join the Stormcloaks or the Imperial Army
achievements.summary: Join either the Stormcloaks in Windhelm or the Imperial Legion in Solitude by completing the chosen faction's joining quest.

guide.context: The two armies share the same achievement set, so faction choice changes names and targets but does not require a second playthrough.

steps.text: Speak with @npc{Ulfric Stormcloak} in Windhelm for Joining the Stormcloaks, or @npc{General Tullius} at Castle Dour for Joining the Legion.
Finish the selected army's initiation assignment and take its oath.

achievements.description: Capture Fort Sungard or Fort Greenwall
achievements.summary: Capture @loc{Fort Sungard} or @loc{Fort Greenwall} during the civil-war questline.

guide.context: Season Unending can transfer holds and change which fort battle appears; a manual save before the peace council protects this missable milestone.

steps.text: Complete Taking Sides by joining either the Stormcloaks in Windhelm or the Imperial Legion in Solitude.
Advance the chosen army's campaign until the journal assigns either the Fort Sungard battle or the Fort Greenwall battle.
Join the assault, reduce the defending-force percentage to zero, and report the victory before advancing past the fort stage.

achievements.summary: Finish the civil war by capturing @loc{Windhelm} for the Legion or @loc{Solitude} for the Stormcloaks.

guide.context: The final capital battle becomes available after the chosen army captures the remaining strategic holds.

steps.text: Complete the civil-war campaign until The Battle for Windhelm or The Battle for Solitude begins.
Fight through the opposing capital, defeat its leadership, and finish the commander's closing dialogue.

achievements.summary: Complete ten journal entries classified as @mechanic{Side Quests}.

guide.context: Main-story, faction, Daedric, and Miscellaneous objectives use different journal categories and do not increase this counter.

steps.text: Open the quest journal and prioritize optional quests shown with the Side Quest category styling.
Complete ten Side Quests and confirm the total under the quest statistics.

achievements.summary: Complete fifty objectives listed in the journal's @mechanic{Miscellaneous} section.

guide.context: A bounty can contribute once for killing the target and again for collecting the reward, making innkeepers, Jarls, and stewards efficient cleanup sources.

steps.text: Speak with townspeople and ask innkeepers, Jarls, or stewards for work that appears under Miscellaneous.
Finish and turn in Miscellaneous objectives until the completed-objective statistic reaches fifty.

achievements.description: Chop wood, mine ore, and cook food
achievements.summary: Chop firewood, mine an ore vein, and cook one food recipe on the same save.

guide.context: The three actions use separate world stations and can be completed immediately after suitable tools and ingredients are found.

steps.text: Equip a @item{Woodcutter's Axe} and use any wood chopping block until firewood is produced.
Equip a @item{Pickaxe} and mine any ore vein until ore is collected.
Use a cooking pot or cooking fire with the listed ingredients and create any food item.

achievements.summary: Successfully pick fifty locks and steal fifty items through pickpocketing.

guide.context: The two counters are independent under General statistics; failed pickpocket attempts and merely opening the pickpocket menu give no credit.

steps.text: Open locked doors and containers until the Locks Picked statistic reaches fifty.
Sneak behind NPCs, save before risky attempts, and successfully remove at least one item from fifty pickpocket inventories.

achievements.summary: Pass one Persuade check, pay one Bribe, and pass one Intimidate check in dialogue.

guide.context: Dialogue labels identify each Speech option, and higher Speech improves the chance of successful Persuade and Intimidate checks.

steps.text: Choose dialogue options explicitly labeled Persuade, Bribe, and Intimidate as they appear during quests.
Succeed at each of the three different Speech checks once; failed attempts do not satisfy that type.

achievements.summary: Activate any @mechanic{Standing Stone} and accept its blessing.

guide.context: The Guardian Stones southwest of Riverwood sit on the opening route and offer the earliest convenient blessings.

steps.text: Approach the Warrior, Mage, or Thief Stone at @loc{The Guardian Stones} and choose the activation prompt to accept a blessing.

achievements.summary: Discover the thirteen named @mechanic{Standing Stones} across Skyrim; activation is unnecessary.

guide.context: The Mage, Thief, and Warrior stones share one Guardian Stones map marker but count as three separate discoveries.

collectibles.name: Apprentice Stone
collectibles.location: Northwest of @loc{Morthal}.
collectibles.method: Approach the stone until its discovery name appears.

collectibles.name: Atronach Stone
collectibles.location: Between @loc{Windhelm} and @loc{Riften}.
collectibles.method: Approach the stone until its discovery name appears.

collectibles.name: Lady Stone
collectibles.location: On @loc{Lake Ilinalta}'s island west of Riverwood.
collectibles.method: Reach the island and approach the stone.

collectibles.name: Lord Stone
collectibles.location: On the mountain east of @loc{Morthal}.
collectibles.method: Climb to the summit and approach the stone.

collectibles.name: Lover Stone
collectibles.location: North of Kolskeggr Mine in the country east of @loc{Markarth}.
collectibles.method: Approach the stone until its discovery registers.

collectibles.name: Mage Stone
collectibles.location: At @loc{The Guardian Stones}, southwest of Riverwood.
collectibles.method: Walk directly to the Mage Stone; the shared map marker alone is insufficient.

collectibles.name: Ritual Stone
collectibles.location: East of @loc{Whiterun}.
collectibles.method: Approach the stone until its discovery registers.

collectibles.name: Serpent Stone
collectibles.location: On the offshore island north of Windhelm, east of Winterhold.
collectibles.method: Reach the island and approach the stone.

collectibles.name: Shadow Stone
collectibles.location: In the mountains south of @loc{Riften}.
collectibles.method: Climb to the stone and trigger its discovery.

collectibles.name: Steed Stone
collectibles.location: West-northwest of @loc{Solitude}, north of the Statue to Meridia.
collectibles.method: Approach the stone until its discovery registers.

collectibles.name: Thief Stone
collectibles.location: At @loc{The Guardian Stones}, southwest of Riverwood.
collectibles.method: Walk directly to the Thief Stone; the shared map marker alone is insufficient.

collectibles.name: Tower Stone
collectibles.location: On the cliff between @loc{Winterhold} and Dawnstar.
collectibles.method: Reach the cliff top and approach the stone.

collectibles.name: Warrior Stone
collectibles.location: At @loc{The Guardian Stones}, southwest of Riverwood.
collectibles.method: Walk directly to the Warrior Stone; the shared map marker alone is insufficient.

achievements.summary: Buy any city house, such as @loc{Breezehome} in Whiterun for 5,000 gold.

guide.context: Breezehome becomes available from Proventus Avenicci after helping Whiterun's Jarl and is the earliest straightforward purchase.

steps.text: Complete Bleak Falls Barrow and Whiterun's early Jarl objectives.
Speak with @npc{Proventus Avenicci} in Dragonsreach, choose the home-purchase dialogue, and pay 5,000 gold for Breezehome.

achievements.summary: Escape from jail by picking the cell lock and reaching the exterior instead of serving the sentence.

guide.context: A manual save before committing the crime allows the bounty and lost inventory state to be reverted after the achievement registers.

steps.text: Commit a witnessed crime, surrender to a guard, and choose the dialogue option that sends the character to jail.
Take the available lockpick, unlock the cell or escape route, and reach the hold's exterior without sleeping in the bed.

achievements.summary: Wear an @item{Amulet of Mara}, propose to an eligible partner, and attend the arranged wedding in Riften.

guide.context: Many potential spouses require a personal quest or Miscellaneous objective before the proposal dialogue appears; race and gender do not restrict eligibility.

steps.text: Pay @npc{Maramal} 200 gold at Riften's Temple of Mara or Bee and Barb to obtain an @item{Amulet of Mara}, then wear the amulet.
Complete the desired partner's prerequisite, speak while wearing the amulet, and select the marriage proposal dialogue.
Ask Maramal to arrange the ceremony, return to the @loc{Temple of Mara} at the scheduled time, and complete the wedding.

achievements.description: Make a smithed item, an enchanted item, and a potion
achievements.summary: Create one smithed item, one enchanted item, and one potion.

guide.context: The three crafting actions can use inexpensive materials, and the enchanted item does not have to be the same object created at the forge.

steps.text: Use any forge with the listed materials and craft an item such as an iron dagger.
Use an Arcane Enchanter with an enchantable item, a known enchantment, and a filled soul gem to create an enchanted item.
Use an Alchemy Lab to combine compatible ingredients and create a potion.

achievements.description: Bounty of 1000 gold in all nine holds
achievements.summary: Maintain an active bounty of at least 1,000 gold in each of Skyrim's nine holds at the same time.

guide.context: Bounties are tracked separately by hold, so paying a fine or serving a sentence removes progress for that hold before the nine-hold check completes.

steps.text: Create a manual save before beginning the bounty run.
Commit a witnessed crime worth at least 1,000 gold in Falkreath, Haafingar, Hjaalmarch, The Pale, The Reach, The Rift, Whiterun, Winterhold, and Eastmarch without clearing any bounty.
After the ninth hold reaches 1,000 gold, wait for the achievement to register before reloading the clean save.

achievements.summary: Carry 100,000 gold in the character's inventory at one time.

guide.context: The check uses current gold rather than lifetime earnings, so house purchases and Hearthfire construction should be finished before the final savings push.

steps.text: Loot valuable gear, sell excess items, complete paid quests, and stop spending until the inventory gold total reaches 100,000.

achievements.summary: Clear fifty dungeons whose map labels display @mechanic{Cleared}.

guide.context: Camps, caves, dragon lairs, Dwarven ruins, forts, giant camps, Nordic tombs, and towers can qualify; a location only contributes after its clear condition is met.

steps.text: Defeat the required enemies or boss in qualifying locations and check the world map for the word Cleared beneath each location name.
Open General statistics and continue clearing new locations until Dungeons Cleared reaches fifty.

achievements.summary: Raise any combat, magic, stealth, or crafting skill to level 100.

guide.context: Skill increases provide character experience as well, so focusing on one frequently used skill also advances the level 50 and level 78 goals.

steps.text: Select one skill used regularly by the build, or a crafting skill supported by stockpiled materials.
Use or train the chosen skill until its displayed value reaches 100.

achievements.summary: Discover one hundred named map locations across Skyrim.

guide.context: Discovery registers when the location name appears on approach; clearing the location is unnecessary for this counter.

steps.text: Visit undiscovered city, settlement, cave, ruin, camp, fort, and landmark icons until General statistics shows one hundred locations discovered.

achievements.summary: Open fifty distinct @item{Skill Books} and receive fifty skill increases from them.

guide.context: Skyrim contains ninety base-game skill books, and the General statistics screen records the number read; ordinary lore books do not contribute.

steps.text: Open books found on named shelves, desks, ruins, guild halls, and quest sites; a qualifying Skill Book immediately raises a skill.
Continue opening distinct Skill Books until the Skill Books Read statistic reaches fifty.

achievements.summary: Complete a Daedric quest and receive one counted @item{Daedric Artifact}.

guide.context: Some Daedric quests offer a non-artifact outcome, so selecting a reward listed in the Oblivion Walker checklist protects both achievements.

steps.text: Complete any Daedric quest through the artifact-awarding outcome and take the named Daedric Artifact into the inventory.

achievements.summary: Obtain the fifteen counted @item{Daedric Artifacts} at least once on one save.

guide.context: The artifacts do not need to remain in the inventory, but every standard artifact route must pay out; the Skeleton Key and Rueful Axe do not count.

collectibles.name: Azura's Star or the Black Star
collectibles.location: The Black Star — @loc{Shrine of Azura}, south of Winterhold.
collectibles.method: Speak with @npc{Aranea Ienith}, recover the Broken Azura's Star from Ilinalta's Deep, and return it to Aranea or Nelacar; enter the star, kill Malyn Varen, and accept either restored star.

collectibles.name: Dawnbreaker
collectibles.location: The Break of Dawn — @loc{Statue to Meridia}, southwest of Solitude; level 12.
collectibles.method: Obtain Meridia's Beacon, place it at the statue, clear Kilkreath Temple, defeat Malkoran, and take Dawnbreaker when Meridia raises the weapon.

collectibles.name: Ebony Blade
collectibles.location: The Whispering Door — @loc{The Bannered Mare} and Dragonsreach in Whiterun; level 20 after Dragon Rising.
collectibles.method: Ask @npc{Hulda} for rumors about the Jarl's children, speak with Balgruuf and Nelkir, steal the Whispering Door key from Farengar or Balgruuf, and take the Ebony Blade from the locked room.

collectibles.name: Ebony Mail
collectibles.location: Boethiah's Calling — @loc{Sacellum of Boethiah}; level 30.
collectibles.method: Read Boethiah's Proving, bring a follower to the shrine, command the follower to use the Pillar of Sacrifice, complete Boethiah's trials, then kill the former champion and equip the Ebony Mail.

collectibles.name: Mace of Molag Bal
collectibles.location: The House of Horrors — Abandoned House in @loc{Markarth}.
collectibles.method: Accept @npc{Vigilant Tyranus}'s request outside the house, obey Molag Bal, free Logrolf from the marked Forsworn camp, allow Logrolf to return to the shrine and become trapped, then finish Molag Bal's commands to receive the mace.

collectibles.name: Masque of Clavicus Vile
collectibles.location: A Daedra's Best Friend — @loc{Falkreath}; level 10.
collectibles.method: Ask the Falkreath guard about a dog, speak with @npc{Lod}, follow Barbas to Haemar's Shame, recover the Rueful Axe from Rimerock Burrow, then spare Barbas and return the axe to receive the Masque.

collectibles.name: Mehrunes' Razor
collectibles.location: Pieces of the Past — @loc{Dawnstar}; level 20.
collectibles.method: Read the courier's museum invitation, speak with @npc{Silus Vesuius}, recover the three Razor fragments, meet Silus at Mehrunes Dagon's shrine, kill Silus when ordered, and take the restored Razor.

collectibles.name: Oghma Infinium
collectibles.location: Discerning the Transmundane — @loc{Septimus Signus's Outpost}; level 15.
collectibles.method: Speak with @npc{Septimus Signus} at his outpost to receive the Lexicon, transcribe it through Alftand, Blackreach, and the Tower of Mzark, collect the five requested elven blood samples, and return for the Oghma Infinium.

collectibles.name: Ring of Hircine or Savior's Hide
collectibles.location: Ill Met by Moonlight — @loc{Falkreath} cemetery and jail.
collectibles.method: Ask @npc{Mathies} about the funeral, speak with jailed @npc{Sinding}, accept the cursed ring, kill the White Stag, and finish Hircine's hunt without attacking beast-form Sinding before the quest starts; receive either the Ring or the Hide.

collectibles.name: Ring of Namira
collectibles.location: The Taste of Death — @loc{Understone Keep} in Markarth.
collectibles.method: Speak with @npc{Brother Verulus}, enter the Hall of the Dead, cooperate with @npc{Eola}, clear Reachcliff Cave, bring Verulus to the feast, kill and consume him, and accept the Ring of Namira.

collectibles.name: Sanguine Rose
collectibles.location: A Night to Remember — a Skyrim tavern; level 14.
collectibles.method: Accept @npc{Sam Guevenne}'s drinking contest, follow the aftermath through Rorikstead and Whiterun, enter Morvunskar's portal, and speak with Sanguine to receive the staff.

collectibles.name: Wabbajack
collectibles.location: The Mind of Madness — @loc{Solitude}.
collectibles.method: Speak with @npc{Dervenin}, obtain the Pelagius Wing key in the Blue Palace, enter Pelagius's mind, solve Sheogorath's three trials, and accept the Wabbajack.

collectibles.name: Skull of Corruption
collectibles.location: Waking Nightmare — @loc{Windpeak Inn} in Dawnstar.
collectibles.method: Agree to help @npc{Erandur}, clear Nightcaller Temple, and kill Erandur when Vaermina speaks during his final ritual; take the Skull before it is destroyed.

collectibles.name: Spellbreaker
collectibles.location: The Only Cure — @loc{Shrine to Peryite}, northeast of Markarth; level 10.
collectibles.method: Speak with @npc{Kesh the Clean}, gather the incense ingredients, commune with Peryite, clear Bthardamz, kill Orchendor, and return to the shrine for Spellbreaker.

collectibles.name: Volendrung
collectibles.location: The Cursed Tribe — @loc{Largashbur}, southwest of Riften; level 9.
collectibles.method: Do not attack the Largashbur Orcs; help @npc{Atub} with a Daedra Heart and Troll Fat, accompany Yamarz, kill the giant and Yamarz, then return the giant's hammer to the shrine so it becomes Volendrung.

achievements.summary: Kill a dragon and remain beside the corpse until one @mechanic{dragon soul} is absorbed.

guide.context: Dragon souls become available after Dragon Rising; leaving the area before the burning-corpse sequence finishes can delay the credit.

steps.text: Defeat any story, random, or dragon-lair dragon after Dragon Rising.
Stay near the dragon's corpse until the visual effect ends and the Dragon Souls counter increases.

achievements.summary: Absorb twenty @mechanic{dragon souls} from defeated dragons.

guide.context: Story dragons, random world encounters, and dragons at marked peaks all contribute, so dedicated farming is best delayed until after the questlines.

steps.text: Visit dragon peaks and respond to random dragon encounters, killing each dragon and remaining near the corpse.
Confirm each absorption in the Dragon Souls counter and continue until twenty souls have been absorbed.

achievements.description: Learn all three words of a shout
achievements.summary: Learn the first, second, and third word belonging to one complete dragon shout.

guide.context: Shearpoint places all three Throw Voice words on one Word Wall, while several main-story quests teach complete shouts automatically.

steps.text: Read the full @loc{Shearpoint} Word Wall for all three Throw Voice words, or finish a story quest that awards all three words of one shout.

achievements.summary: Learn twenty distinct dragon shouts by reading Word Walls or receiving story-taught shouts.

guide.context: The counter tracks learned shout names rather than unlocked words, so spending dragon souls is not required; Dawnguard and Dragonborn shouts can contribute.

steps.text: Complete the main story and faction routes that award shout words.
Clear dragon peaks and Nordic ruins, read Word Walls for new shout names, and continue until the Magic menu lists twenty learned shouts.

achievements.summary: Increase character skills until the character reaches level 5.

guide.context: Every skill increase contributes character experience, so normal combat, crafting, stealth, and magic use all advance this early milestone.

steps.text: Use skills and claim the level-up when enough character experience has accumulated to reach level 5.

achievements.summary: Increase character skills until the character reaches level 10.

guide.context: Every skill increase contributes character experience, so normal combat, crafting, stealth, and magic use all advance this early milestone.

steps.text: Use skills and claim the level-up when enough character experience has accumulated to reach level 10.

achievements.summary: Increase character skills until the character reaches level 25.

guide.context: Higher levels require many skill increases; making mastered skills Legendary allows those skills to be raised again while preserving overall character level.

steps.text: Use skills and claim the level-up when enough character experience has accumulated to reach level 25.

achievements.summary: Increase character skills until the character reaches level 50.

guide.context: Higher levels require many skill increases; making mastered skills Legendary allows those skills to be raised again while preserving overall character level.

steps.text: Use skills and claim the level-up when enough character experience has accumulated to reach level 50.

achievements.summary: Complete the Dawnguard quest Awakening by freeing Serana from @loc{Dimhollow Crypt}.

guide.context: Dawnguard begins after the vampire-hunter invitation and opens the route to Fort Dawnguard; the faction choice occurs after Awakening.

steps.text: Travel to @loc{Fort Dawnguard}, speak with @npc{Isran}, and follow the investigation to Dimhollow Crypt.
Solve the central brazier puzzle, open the monolith, speak with @npc{Serana}, and finish Awakening.

achievements.summary: Complete Beyond Death by entering the @loc{Soul Cairn}, defeating its three Keepers, and rescuing Valerica.

guide.context: Beyond Death follows Chasing Echoes and provides the first opportunity to meet Durnehviir, whose later summons teach Soul Tear.

steps.text: Follow @npc{Serana} through Chasing Echoes and use the portal in Castle Volkihar's laboratory.
Find @npc{Valerica}, defeat the three Keepers, kill @enemy{Durnehviir}, and complete her Elder Scroll objective.

achievements.summary: Complete Kindred Judgment by defeating @enemy{Lord Harkon} at Castle Volkihar.

guide.context: The Dawnguard finale follows Touching the Sky and supplies Auriel's Bow plus Sunhallowed Elven Arrows before the final battle.

steps.text: Complete Touching the Sky and take @item{Auriel's Bow} from Knight-Paladin Gelebor.
Return to @loc{Castle Volkihar}, use Auriel's Bow during the confrontation, and defeat Lord Harkon.

achievements.summary: Complete Lost to the Ages by finding four Aetherium Shards and crafting a reward at the @loc{Aetherium Forge}.

guide.context: Reading The Aetherium Wars or entering Arkngthamz starts the quest, so losing access to one starting method does not block the other.

steps.text: Read @item{The Aetherium Wars} or enter @loc{Arkngthamz} and speak with @npc{Katria}.
Recover the four Aetherium Shards, combine the shards into the Aetherium Crest, and use the crest at the Ruins of Bthalft.
Reach the @loc{Aetherium Forge}, defeat its guardians, and forge one of the three Aetherial rewards.

achievements.description: Learn all three words of Soul Tear
achievements.summary: Summon @enemy{Durnehviir} successfully three times outdoors to learn all three Soul Tear words.

guide.context: Durnehviir becomes summonable after Beyond Death, and each of the first three completed summons teaches the next Soul Tear word.

steps.text: Spend dragon souls to unlock the learned words of Summon Durnehviir.
Aim at a broad, flat outdoor area and summon Durnehviir; wait for his lesson, let the shout recharge, and complete two more successful summons.

achievements.description: Use the special power of Auriel's Bow
achievements.summary: Fire @item{Auriel's Bow} with a Sunhallowed Elven Arrow directly into the sun.

guide.context: Touching the Sky supplies Auriel's Bow and twelve Sunhallowed Elven Arrows; perform the special shot before selling or discarding the unique bow.

steps.text: After Touching the Sky, equip @item{Auriel's Bow} and select @item{Sunhallowed Elven Arrows}.
Stand outdoors during daylight, aim directly at the visible sun, and release a fully drawn arrow.

achievements.summary: Buy all eleven @mechanic{Werewolf} perks after earning progress by feeding on corpses in beast form.

guide.context: The Companions grant lycanthropy; Aela can restore the form only once after a cure, so complete the tree before replacing lycanthropy repeatedly.

steps.text: Advance the Companions to The Silver Hand and accept the ritual in the Underforge.
Transform, feed on human corpses, and buy perks along the right branch until Savage Feeding permits feeding on animal corpses.
Continue feeding in beast form and spend every earned point until all eleven werewolf perks are purchased.

achievements.summary: Buy all eleven @mechanic{Vampire Lord} perks after earning progress with Vampire Lord abilities.

guide.context: Harkon offers the form after Awakening on the vampire route; on the Dawnguard route, Serana can grant and normally restore the form while she remains an uncured follower.

steps.text: Accept @npc{Harkon}'s gift after escorting Serana home, or ask @npc{Serana} to make the character a Vampire Lord.
Transform and kill enemies with Vampire Lord powers that award perk progress.
Spend every earned point in the Vampire Lord tree until all eleven perks are purchased.

achievements.summary: Pay @npc{Galathil} 1,000 gold in Riften's Ragged Flagon and open the face-sculpting service.

guide.context: Galathil becomes reachable after entering the Ragged Flagon; the achievement registers when her service opens even if no facial feature is changed.

steps.text: Find Galathil in @loc{The Ragged Flagon}, select the face-sculpting dialogue, pay 1,000 gold, and confirm the appearance screen.

achievements.summary: Reach level 78 or higher, find a naturally spawned @enemy{Legendary Dragon}, and defeat it.

guide.context: Legendary Dragons do not enter the natural spawn pool before level 78, and dragons created with console commands do not satisfy the achievement.

steps.text: Continue raising skills and character levels until at least level 78.
Travel among discovered dragon peaks and outdoor areas until a dragon named Legendary Dragon appears.
Kill the naturally spawned Legendary Dragon and remain nearby until the victory registers.

achievements.summary: Prepare a child's bedroom, adopt an eligible child, and assign the child to the prepared home.

guide.context: A city house needs the children's-bedroom upgrade; a Hearthfire homestead needs both a child's bed and a child's chest.

steps.text: Buy or build an eligible home and install the required child's bed and storage.
Speak with @npc{Constance Michel} at Honorhall Orphanage or an eligible orphan, choose the adoption dialogue, and select the prepared home.

achievements.summary: Pay 5,000 gold for a Hearthfire land plot in Falkreath, Dawnstar, or Morthal.

guide.context: Each hold requires the Jarl's favor and may require local assistance before the steward offers the land-purchase dialogue.

steps.text: Complete the Jarl's prerequisite and any requested citizen-help objectives in Falkreath, Dawnstar, or Morthal.
Speak with that hold's Jarl or steward and pay 5,000 gold for the offered plot.

achievements.description: Build three wings on a house
achievements.summary: Build the Main Hall and all three wings on one Hearthfire homestead.

guide.context: Wing choices can differ, and furnishing is unnecessary; only the completed structural sections matter.

steps.text: At one purchased plot, use the drafting table and carpenter's workbench to complete the Small House and Main Hall.
Select and fully construct one East Wing, one North Wing, and one West Wing at the same homestead.

achievements.summary: Buy the three 5,000-gold Hearthfire plots in Falkreath, Dawnstar, and Morthal.

guide.context: The three holds have separate Jarl-favor requirements, and civil-war changes can replace the Jarl without removing the need to qualify locally.

steps.text: Complete the required Jarl and citizen-help tasks in Falkreath, Dawnstar, and Morthal.
Purchase Lakeview Manor, Heljarchen Hall, and Windstad Manor from the appropriate Jarl or steward for 15,000 gold total.

achievements.summary: Fully construct all three Hearthfire houses with a Main Hall, three wings, and cellar on every plot.

guide.context: Furniture does not control this achievement, but the structures consume substantial lumber, quarried stone, clay, iron fittings, hinges, locks, and nails.

steps.text: Assign stewards where useful and stockpile sawn logs, quarried stone, clay, iron ingots, and gold.
At Lakeview Manor, Heljarchen Hall, and Windstad Manor, construct the Small House, Main Hall, East Wing, North Wing, West Wing, and cellar.

achievements.summary: Travel from Windhelm to @loc{Solstheim} during the opening Dragonborn quest.

guide.context: The Dragonborn route begins after cultists confront the player and their orders point to the island.

steps.text: Defeat the cultists, read their orders, and travel to the Windhelm docks.
Pay or persuade @npc{Gjalund Salt-Sage} to sail to Solstheim and remain aboard until Raven Rock loads.

achievements.summary: Complete The Temple of Miraak by exploring the temple with Frea and reading its @item{Black Book}.

guide.context: This is the first major Dragonborn story dungeon and provides one of the five Black Books needed for Hidden Knowledge.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Frea} at @loc{Temple of Miraak} and follow her through the ruin.
Reach the final chamber, read the Black Book Waking Dreams, survive the Apocrypha sequence, and finish the quest conversation.

achievements.summary: Complete The Path of Knowledge by opening @loc{Nchardak} with Neloth and recovering the Black Book Epistolary Acumen.

guide.context: This main-story step comes after restoring the Skaal and cleansing Solstheim's stones, and it supplies a second required Black Book.

steps.text: Follow the Dragonborn story to @npc{Neloth} at Tel Mithryn and travel with him to Nchardak.
Use the control cubes to restore the ruin's systems, reach the reading room, and read @item{Epistolary Acumen}.

achievements.summary: Complete At the Summit of Apocrypha by riding Sahrotaar and defeating @enemy{Miraak}.

guide.context: The finale follows The Gardener of Men and requires all three Bend Will words; its forced dragon ride counts toward Dragonrider.

steps.text: Learn and unlock all three words of Bend Will, then read @item{Waking Dreams}.
Cross the Apocrypha chapters, use Bend Will on @enemy{Sahrotaar}, and ride the dragon to Miraak.
Fight Miraak through every healing phase and complete Hermaeus Mora's closing sequence.

achievements.description: Learn all 3 words of Dragon Aspect
achievements.summary: Learn the three @mechanic{Dragon Aspect} words from the Temple of Miraak, Raven Rock Mine, and Apocrypha.

guide.context: The three Word Walls are split between the Dragonborn story and The Final Descent, so Raven Rock's mine quest is required in addition to the main DLC route.

collectibles.name: Dragon Aspect — first word
collectibles.location: @loc{Temple of Miraak}.
collectibles.method: Read the Word Wall while completing The Temple of Miraak.

collectibles.name: Dragon Aspect — second word
collectibles.location: @loc{Raven Rock Mine}.
collectibles.method: Complete The Final Descent far enough to reach and read the mine's Word Wall.

collectibles.name: Dragon Aspect — third word
collectibles.location: @loc{Apocrypha}.
collectibles.method: Read the Word Wall during At the Summit of Apocrypha before the Miraak battle.

achievements.description: Learn the secrets of 5 Black Books
achievements.summary: Reach the reward chamber in five different @item{Black Books} and choose one secret from each.

guide.context: The Temple of Miraak and The Path of Knowledge provide two story books; only three of the five optional books are then needed.

steps.text: Complete The Temple of Miraak and The Path of Knowledge, reaching the reward chamber and selecting a power in each Black Book.
Choose three additional books from Kolbjorn Barrow, Tel Mithryn, White Ridge Barrow, Raven Rock Mine, and Benkongerike.
Complete each chosen Apocrypha route and select a reward at the final pedestal until five Black Book secrets have been learned.

achievements.description: Craft an item out of Stalhrim
achievements.summary: Complete A New Source of Stalhrim, reach Smithing 80 with Ebony Smithing, and craft one @item{Stalhrim} item.

guide.context: Baldor Iron-Shaper teaches the recipe after his rescue; protect him until the quest is finished because losing the Skaal blacksmith can close the crafting route.

steps.text: After The Fate of the Skaal, make a manual save before returning to Skaal Village; let Deor Woodcutter and Fanari Strong-Voice finish their conversation, then speak with Deor about missing @npc{Baldor Iron-Shaper}.
Rescue Baldor, recover the Thalmor map, and return the map to him to complete A New Source of Stalhrim.
Obtain an @item{Ancient Nordic Pickaxe}, acquire Stalhrim, raise Smithing to 80, buy Ebony Smithing, and forge any Stalhrim weapon or armor piece.

achievements.summary: Use the full @mechanic{Bend Will} shout to tame and mount five dragons.

guide.context: The forced Sahrotaar ride during At the Summit of Apocrypha counts once; dragons in either Skyrim or Solstheim can supply the other four rides.

steps.text: Complete the Dragonborn story until all three Bend Will words are learned and unlocked.
Aim the full Bend Will shout at a dragon, wait for the dragon to land, mount the dragon, then dismount after the ride; perform this on five counted rides.

achievements.description: Own a house in Raven Rock
achievements.summary: Complete March of the Dead, The Final Descent, and Served Cold to receive @loc{Severin Manor} in Raven Rock.

guide.context: The property is a free quest reward rather than a purchase, and The Final Descent also contains a Dragon Aspect Word Wall.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Captain Veleth} near Old Attius Farm south of Raven Rock and complete March of the Dead.
Speak with @npc{Crescius Caerellius} in Raven Rock Mine and complete The Final Descent.
Accept Served Cold, finish the conspiracy investigation, and complete the final report to receive Severin Manor.

achievements.description: Discover 30 locations on the island of Solstheim
achievements.summary: Discover thirty named map locations on @loc{Solstheim}.

guide.context: Only discoveries on the island count, and a location registers on approach without needing to be cleared.

steps.text: Travel across Raven Rock, the ash wastes, the northern coast, Skaal territory, Tel Mithryn, ruins, barrows, caves, and standing-stone sites until thirty Solstheim discoveries register.
